scope: C-01/C-02: identities remain stable; a sealed version witnesses an identity assertion at its claim address
caveats: Identifiers here are fixed manually authored symbolic claim/referent coordinates, not runtime-minted NodeGuids.
The version of a claim at its thought address is its historical witness; no separate witness entity or foreign-key lookup is created.
The source root is separately retained in the version receipt for evidential independence. Neither the thought slot nor the version number by itself proves that sources are independent.
An attestation being present in a version witnesses the assertion in the test history; it does not establish externally observed coreference truth.
Read horizons use dataset + branch + version, never a naked version or latest/unbounded temporal default.
No production R2IL relation join, CE64 truth promotion, actual Lance manifest or real-world source attestation is claimed.
